marketing_description: The EDGE® Edge Series safety glass features a unisex design with a 146 mm black nylon Makalu frame and 14 mm bridge size, complemented by black thermoplastic rubber Edge-Flex temples. It is equipped with black polarized polycarbonate lenses featuring a Vapor Shield anti-fog coating and 99-100% UV protection. Designed for protective eyewear needs, this model meets ANSI Z87.1 and EN 166 standards.
